added.reason: R26 air-flap edge rules are relevant only if the grille has movable intake or outlet flaps; the spec does not confirm them.
added.model_condition: The grill/air-guide parts include movable air intake or outlet flaps (e.g. active grille shutters).
added.original_text: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. in all positions of use.
added.submitted_text: If the bumper grille has movable air intake or outlet flaps, air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. in all positions of use.
added.quote: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use.

added.reason: R26 aerial end-cap radius applies only to an exposed external aerial; the specified keyless aerial may be internal.
added.model_condition: Keyless-entry aerial has an external shaft with an unattached end
added.original_text: The unattached ends of aerials shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm, although shafts of aerials may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm.
added.submitted_text: If an external keyless-entry aerial has an unattached end, the unattached ends of aerials shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm, although shafts of aerials may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm.
added.quote: Shafts of aerials may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm. However, the unattached ends shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm.

added.reason: R42 low-speed impactor mass sets an independently testable bumper-test condition.
added.original_text: The effective mass of the impactor shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the "unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.
added.submitted_text: The effective mass of the impactor shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the "unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.
added.quote: The effective mass shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the “unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.

added.reason: R42 recovery time applies if the bumper protective device uses self-restoring material; the EPP absorber makes this plausible.
added.model_condition: Protective device includes self-restoring materials (e.g. EPP absorber)
added.original_text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
added.submitted_text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
added.quote: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.

added.reason: R48 multipart signalling-lamp geometry applies only if the lamp has distinct apparent-surface parts.
added.model_condition: The bumper signalling lamp is a single lamp whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts.
added.original_text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
added.submitted_text: If a bumper signalling lamp has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
added.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

added.reason: R48 mode switching rule applies only if a direction indicator supports static and sequential modes.

added.original_text: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
added.submitted_text: If a bumper direction indicator supports static and sequential modes, a direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
added.quote: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential), shall not switch between both modes once activated.
